# Climbing

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Movement](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Climbing)*

While you're climbing, each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot (2 extra feet in [Difficult Terrain](Difficult-Terrain.md)). You ignore this extra cost if you have a [Climb Speed](Climb-Speed.md) and use it to climb.

At the DM's option, climbing a slippery surface or one with few handholds might require a successful DC 15 Strength ([Athletics](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#Skills)) check.
